descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Telecomunicații, Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Tehnologie, informații și mass-media
How would you like to work in IT, toying with cutting edge technologies and enjoying your life? At Orange Services, it’s possible! 
 As one of the largest IT Hub within Orange Group, we are working internationally for both Orange corporate functions and country operations. Through a unique combination of know-how and expertise, our teams provide a broad range of IT & Business Solutions. 
 Software Developer - MyEAP platform & AI Integration 
 What we’re looking for 
 Working in a team in charge of managing the Energy Action Plan for Orange group to achieve its objectives in terms of energy consumption reduction, energy expenses and related CO2 emissions, you will contribute to the tool’s technical development which supports this commitment.
 You will contribute to the technical aspects of the software team by making architectural, design specifications, develop new features, guiding team members in technical matters. 
 You will contribute by your competence into development, coding, testing, and debugging the application. Writing testable, scalable, and efficient code and leading code reviews.
 What you’ll be doing 
 MyEAP Tool Development & Support 
Contribute to MyEAP development.
Perform manual testing , track issues, and validate implemented fixes.
Contribute to vulnerability assessment and ensure the main functionalities of the application.
Track development tasks and support the team through GitLab activity boards .
Contribute to technical and functional documentation, including user manuals, module descriptions, and formulas.
 Functional Coordination & New Features 
Gather user feedback and translate needs into functional requirements.
Support user training and troubleshoot access issues.
Contribute to new feature development from ideas to production .
Participate in defining module needs and functionalities.
Design mock-ups , contribute to UI/UX , prepare specification files, follow development, and test modules before and after production launch.
 IT Technical activities 
Participate in the project’s technical design with the Product Owner, project manager, and technical experts.
Ensure the technical consistency of the different project modules.
Contribute to planning, quality follow-up, and delivery within deadlines.
Provide technical guidance to the team and contribute to problem solving.
Participate in development activities with the technical team.
Write progress reports and present updates to stakeholders.
 AI / LLM Contribution 
Contribute to the identification and integration of AI / LLM use cases within the MyEAP tool;
Support the design of AI-assisted features such as smart search, user support, recommendation systems, or automated content generation.
Participate in defining requirements, testing outputs, and validating the relevance of AI-generated results.
Work with technical teams to ensure proper integration of AI services into the application architecture.
Monitor AI/LLM trends and propose relevant innovations for the tool.
 What you need to know/have 
 Technical skills 
Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer .
Strong experience in web application development .
Solid knowledge of Java (Spring), Angular, MySQL, GitLab, CI/CD .
Good knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bootstrap .
Knowledge of back-end technologies such as Java and Python .
Familiarity with databases, web servers, and UI/UX design .
Understanding manual testing , issue tracking, and technical documentation.
Familiarity with AI / LLM concepts , prompt design, AI-assisted workflows, or integration of AI services into applications.
 Other skills 
Communication, coordination, time management, and project follow-up skills.
Ability to formalize needs and work with both technical and business stakeholders.
Fluent in technical English ; French is a plus.
 Soft skills 
Active listening
Good interpersonal skills
Team spirit
Creativity
Rigor and organization
 What’s in it for you: 
Performance Bonuses – based on your results & the company’s; 
Loyalty Bonuses, if you extend your stay; 
Electronic Meal Tickets - as you imagine; 
Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too; 
#WFH & Flexible hours; 
Professional GSM subscription; 
Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!]; 
Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services; 
Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring; 
Wellbeing Programs – we support your Zen; 
 Orange Services is about bringing together people and technology. 
 Come & work for a #TopEmployer company. You could be part of an organization where great colleagues and team spirit support your professional development. 
 Apply and let’s have a remote-talk. 
 At Orange, you can. 
 We encourage all candidate profiles, regardless of gender, age, race, citizenship, ethnicity, color, language, religion, social origin, genetic traits, sexual orientation, permanent or temporary disability, nationality, political choice, social category or social origins, situation or family responsibility, belonging to a disadvantaged category, membership or trade union activity.
